name: Alone Australia
description: Ten Australians are dropped off alone in separate areas of the Tasmanian wilderness where they must deal with the forces of nature, hunger, and loneliness.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ten outdoor survivalists are challenged with surviving totally alone for as long as they can in Tasmania's wilderness in the middle of winter.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The contestants start to tap out of the competition, as they find out how tough a Tasmanian winter can be and the conditions prove too tough for some.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Three days into the competition in the Tasmanian wilderness, three participants have already left, and the rest are feeling the effects of going without food.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The participants reveal the sources of their strength as they contend with hunger, the elements, and their own thoughts in the Tasmanian wilderness.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The participants struggle with hunger, fatigue, cold, and the question of whether this challenge is worth it.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After making it through the settling-in period, the remaining participants figure out their own strategies, which they hope will allow them to outstay their competitors.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The contestants approach two weeks in the wilderness and, with most of them not having caught anything to eat, food is becoming a critical issue and desperation is growing.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Survival in the wilderness proves to be just one part of the challenge. Emotional isolation weighs heavily on the participants, and the toll is too great for one person.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The remaining competitors in the Tasmanian wilderness have no idea how much longer the competition will go on for, heightening the daily challenges.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: After more than a month alone in the Tasmanian wilderness, the three remaining people share a single thought--how much longer will I be out here?

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The worsening weather poses a tough challenge for the contestants. As it becomes apparent that a change of strategy is significant to their survival and success, they are forced to make some tough choices.

videos.title: The Reunion
videos.overview: Amanda Keller hosts as the entire cast come together for the first time since they were dropped into the remote wilds of Western Tasmania.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ten survivalists take on the wilderness of New Zealand's South Island, documenting their own isolated battles and striving to be the last person standing to win $250,000.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The contestants try to adapt to the extreme conditions on the South Island of New Zealand, where they face near-zero temperatures, icy-cold winds, relentless rainfall and vicious sandflies.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The participants' focus turns to food. Some want to head up the mountains to hunt deer, while others opt for fish and berries. But with limited calories and tools, procuring food is no easy task, so they must think outside the box or risk starvation.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: With difficulties of acquiring food, some find it challenging to trust their own judgement, while others start to feel the true effects of isolation.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Torrential rain batters New Zealand's South Island, with contestants facing danger if they brave the elements to hunt or starvation if they don't.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: New Zealand's wild weather, lack of food and some bad luck force all of the contestants to dig deep in order to survive.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Frustration reaches a tipping point for most of the contestants, as finding food proves difficult for some and a severe storm rolls in over the horizon.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A dangerous storm hits, testing the contestants' resilience and shelters. Who will weather the rain, and who will struggle to adapt?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The cold weather has set in, making it ever more difficult for the participants to catch food; as hunger kicks in, desperation takes over.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As the end of the competition nears, the final participants battle against nature and themselves. One of them will take home the $250K prize.

videos.title: Reunion Special
videos.overview:
The Reunion brings the entire cast together for the first time since they were dropped into the extreme and wild terrain of New Zealand's South Island (Aotearoa's Te Waipounamu), having to survive completely isolated from the world and each other, and stripped of modern possessions and comforts.

Join Andreas, Chace, Jack, Jason, Krzysztof, Leanne, Mike, Rick, Suzan and Tamika as they compare their strategies and experiences for the very first time, reveal the toughest struggles they faced and are shown surprising, unseen footage.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ten survivalists are dropped into the West Coast Ranges of Tasmania for the challenge of a lifetime: to survive in the wild without any human contact. Only the last one standing can win $250,000.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: In a battle against time, the survivalists hurry to establish shelters or catch food before their energy reserves run out.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A triumphant catch staves off the hunger of one survivalist, but as the adrenaline of the adventure fades, can the others pivot their strategies to bring in food?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A shock medical complication threatens to remove one of our toughest participants, while isolation begins to take its toll.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The survivalists' race to catch a wallaby and procure much-needed protein is on... who will be the first to eat red meat?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Food is in extraordinary abundance for some survivalists, while others struggle with empty bellies as they question their future in the competition.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: One survivalist's body begins to shut down, another is forced to reckon with their emotions, and a wildlife encounter threatens another's chances at winning.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The remaining survivalists come face to face with their physical limitations. Can innovation save the day, or will a routine med check bring one survivalist to the end of their journey?

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The survivalists' bodies are under more stress than ever before. As winter closes in, a swell of rain raises the lake's level, potentially putting shelters at risk.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: With physical and environmental conditions deteriorating, our survivalists are forced to make difficult decisions about their future.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: As the three remaining participants enter the final stretch, a pademelon catch changes the course of the game.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Shay eats pademelon, Muzza rejoins the game with a big eel catch and Corrine sustains herself with insects and determination; emotions surge, bodies fail and one person leaves with $250,000.

videos.title: Reunion Special
videos.overview: Kumi Taguchi looks back at the record-breaking achievements of the 10 participants and their time on the land, with incredible unseen footage, surprising insights and new revelations.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Alone Australia heads to the Arctic Circle, where ten new contenders confront isolation and relentless cold in the show’s most punishing season yet.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As the Arctic chill deepens, ten survivalists are pushed to their limits; one man’s first catch ignites hope, while for others, a navigational mistake and an injury threaten to cut their journey short.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: With the cold settling in, the remaining participants battle injury, hunger, and the slow creep of isolation. One risky move on the water could mean the difference between resilience and rescue.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: With fishing scarce and the cold closing in, two canoes take to the freezing lake in search of deeper waters. And while some find bounty, others find the end of their journey.
